features.text: Dual-hinged support system provides superior medial and lateral knee stabilization while allowing natural movement
Premium neoprene material delivers therapeutic warmth to help reduce pain and stiffness
Wraparound design ensures easy application and a customized fit for optimal support
Professional-grade compression helps reduce swelling and promotes healing
Versatile support suitable for both post-operative recovery and chronic condition management

measurement: For optimal therapeutic benefits and support, measure the circumference of your knee at the center of the patella (mid-patella). Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for detailed sizing guidance and expert fitting assistance.
